name: OnRe
steps: Check the excluded countries list first. The app blocks restricted locations, and Romania, the UK and the US are on the list.
Use a Solana wallet: "Any Solana wallet supported by WalletConnect (80+ compatible wallets)." The Open Access route needs no sign-up and no KYC.

Get ONyc. On app.onre.finance/earn , choose Open Access, enter USDC or USDG and press Purchase. "ONyc currently mints against USDC and USDG." You can also buy it: "Secondary liquidity is available 24/7 via Orca, Raydium, Jupiter."

Hold it for 1x, or move it to a supported venue for 2x to 6x, plus the Kamino 10x boost while it lasts. Warning Looping borrows against your ONyc, so a price drop can liquidate the position, and liquidity pools carry impermanent loss. Use leverage only with money you can afford to lose.
If you want referral points, make a code in the dashboard. A wallet you refer only counts after it holds 100 ONyc.
Track your total on the leaderboard or the public points API: "The ONyc Points API is publicly accessible and does not require an API key."
Plan your exit before you buy. Open Access holders sell on a DEX; redeeming through OnRe needs a verified wallet and, per OnRe's own disclaimer, qualified investor status.
what: No OnRe airdrop is confirmed. Holding or deploying ONyc on Solana earns OnRe Points, which have no stated value. Steps, multipliers, fees, who is excluded.
behind: OnRe's blog names Dan Roberts as co-founder and CEO, and Ayyan Rahman: "said Ayyan Rahman, Co-Founder and CGO at OnRe". On Re SAC Ltd. holds Bermuda Monetary Authority licences, "Registration number: 55347". On 5 May 2026 OnRe announced its Series A: "The two firms co-led OnRe's $5 million Series A round", meaning Forward Industries and RockawayX. Cointelegraph reported the same round. RockawayX s
costs: There is no free route: points come only from ONyc you hold or deploy. "Minting ONyc carries no mint fee. Users pay network fees on Solana." Fees come out of the NAV instead: "OnRe charges an annual investment management fee of 0.75% of average net assets", and "OnRe charges a 20% performance management fee on adjusted profit generated by the applicable segregated account." Redeeming through OnRe
risks: Nothing is owed. Points have no value and no token is promised. Your capital carries reinsurance risk. If claims exceed reserves, the NAV can fall. Retail holders cannot redeem with the regulated company: "ONyc tokens accessed through this Interface do not confer any ownership, redemption, governance, or other legal or contractual rights against On Re SAC Ltd. or its affiliates."
